examiner_comment: Clear position and relevant ideas, but development is general and examples are thin. Frequent errors in plurals, articles and verb forms ('many city', 'more faster', 'it is not solve'). Simple linking repeated (Firstly, Secondly, However).

All three parts of the question answered with a clear position. Well organised with natural linking. Good range of vocabulary. A few agreement errors ('limiting students ... ignore', 'students who ... tends') keep grammar at 6 to 6.5. Second body paragraph could be extended with a concrete example.

Fully addresses the question with a clear, consistent position. Ideas are well extended and supported with specific examples. Cohesion is skilful and largely unobtrusive. Wide, precise vocabulary ('mitigated', 'informal mentoring'). Almost all sentences error-free.

Under the 250-word minimum, which limits Task Response. Both parts of the question are touched on but ideas are listed rather than developed. Basic vocabulary and frequent errors in plurals and verb forms.

Clear overview and accurate figures. Key features selected, though the comparison of growth rates could be sharper. Cohesion is clear but repetitive ('Country A', 'Country C'). Adequate vocabulary with some repetition of 'increased' and 'grew'.
All three bullet points covered with a clear purpose and consistently formal tone. Logical paragraphing. Mostly accurate grammar with a reasonable range. Vocabulary is appropriate but fairly safe.
